target_customer: Media companies, podcasters, marketers and creators that want short social clips from long videos
problem: Turning long form video into captioned short clips and publishing them takes media teams thousands of hours.
business_model: Performance priced AI clipping service, priced on views the clips earn per the company site
product_category: AI video clipping and publishing agents

founders.name: Jonathan Baer
founders.background_notes: Education and employers not listed on the YC page.

founders.name: Casey Traina
founders.background_notes: Education and employers not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal understanding of video to find moments, caption, edit and publish across social platforms is standard applied ML with hard parts around quality at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Many clipping tools exist and the company stresses customers own their accounts, which lowers lock in. Case studies with media brands add some relationship stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Clipping became a feature in larger editors and many tools; no acquisition of Overlap found.

market_need_then: Podcast and long form video publishers wanted short clips for social distribution. The site cites iHeartMedia and morning show case studies, which are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses overlap.ai; an unrelated Product Hunt product is also called Overlap. Legal entity is Vastly, Inc. per an aggregator.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: confident and somewhat playful, outcome focused, with bold claims such as a headline views counter

branding.brand_signature: Prompted by You, Edited by AI tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch on 2025-05-20 reached 250 upvotes, 31 comments and a Launch of the Day award per Product Hunt.

brand_strength.rationale: Won Product Hunt Launch of the Day but the name is generic and shared with other products.

outcome_analysis: Overlap is active with nine people and shows named media customers on its site, but no verified funding or revenue was found. It competes in a crowded AI clipping market where larger editors added similar features. Its performance based pricing and ownership pitch are differentiators, yet the outcome is still unresolved.
notes: Funding: one aggregator lists a $500K seed in June 2024 with Y Combinator, another directory lists $1.9M total; both unverified and conflicting, so no round is recorded. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Competitor search returned only 2026 roundups, so the dated list is empty. Name origin and logo not found.
